Nothing is selected or derived here: every published indicator, keyed i01–i57 in the source's own order, units as served (₹ lakh for money, counts and mandays plain, kWh and tonnes where marked). Stock-change indicators (24–27) and Net Profit (30) can be legitimately negative. Two source defects are handled and disclosed: the 2023-24 4-digit copies of indicators 36–49 arrive shifted one indicator down and are outvoted by the clean 2- and 3-digit copies; indicator 36 (children workers) exists ONLY as one such corrupt row and is quarantined — 56 of 57 indicators are baked.
